## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-inspired game about building a tower and having a friend attack it.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game using Canvas 2D with a pseudo-3D art style and responsive controls.
- Game loop includes a build phase, an attack phase, three shots, scoring, and replay.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added game UI, styling, build-piece inventory, and canvas-based game rendering.
- Implemented piece placement/removal, rotation, undo, aiming, shots, block collision, pig hit, and result/replay UI.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript and gameplay, fix any bugs, and capture/inspect a screenshot.

### Blocked
- `node --check game.js` failed earlier with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '}'`; the code was subsequently rewritten, but syntax validation was not rerun.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and resolve any syntax/runtime issues.
2. Open the running game in a browser, exercise build and attack controls, and check responsive layout.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize the result and assumptions for the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and page structure.
- `style.css`: Responsive layout and visual styling.
- `game.js`: Game rendering, interactions, and gameplay logic.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A Python HTTP server was launched with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser verification has not yet been completed.

- Build a complete, playable “3D Angry Birds” game where the player builds a tower and a friend attacks it.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

- Added game UI, styling, build-piece inventory, and canvas game rendering.
- Implemented piece placement/removal, rotation, undo, aiming, shots, block collision, pig hit, and result/replay UI.
- Rewrote `game.js`; `node --check game.js` now passes.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002; confirmed its endpoint responds.

### Active
- Verify the game in a browser, exercise build and attack controls, and check responsive layout.
- Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` in a browser and check for runtime errors.
2. Exercise building, rotating/removing pieces, firing shots, scoring, and replay; check a mobile-sized layout.
3. Save a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only that latest screenshot.
4. Summarize the result and assumptions for the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and page structure.
- `style.css`: Responsive layout and visual styling.
- `game.js`: Rendering, interactions, and gameplay logic.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
